reviews.author: Y K
reviews.text:
May 7, 2024, 6:30 PM, Yongsan Hannam-dong branch. I just left the store and it was an absolutely horrible experience! I was so angry!

It was okay at first. We asked the staff on the second floor if we could try on the pants, and the staff led us to the changing room. After leaving the locker room, three female employees on the second floor stared at us for a long time without any reason. It was a little uncomfortable, but I thought they were just staring.

But then something really strange happened. We went downstairs, and while one of the group was trying on two women's tops in the locker room and another was trying on pants, a thin, curly-haired, bespectacled male employee on the first floor was laughing hysterically inside the store. He rushed downstairs, picked up the clothes our group had just tried on, and mocked them loudly. (The female clerk on the first floor also seemed quite happy.) Although they could not understand Korean, their expressions and tone of voice were clearly unfriendly. Then, like a dog, it sniffed all the clothes on display and sprayed perfume all over the space we were in. (And we hadn't even left the locker room yet.) It was a truly horrible experience. It was rainy and cold outside, and since we weren't sweating or wearing perfume, there was no way our clothes would smell. And yet you behave so humiliatingly in front of guests! We left there angry. Any store that employs such rude staff clearly doesn't expect regular customers!

But the head office has so much money that they don't seem to care about customers like us. Even though there are so many bad reviews, there doesn't seem to be any will to improve. This service attitude is truly terrible.

Those looking to purchase this brand are strongly recommended to purchase from other countries or branches. The service is really poor.

reviews.text:
I do not recommend purchasing from Elborn if you plan on shipping internationally.

I purchased a bag from Elborn, but was so disappointed with the quality and physical appearance that I requested a return.

Elborn insisted that I use DHL for returns. However, I initially provided an incorrect zip code as the return shipping address, and the city and zip code did not match, so I asked for confirmation.

I spent over $300 on nothing. This is because I had to cover all overseas shipping costs, return shipping costs, customs/GST costs to the shipping country, and customs duties incurred when returning to Korea.

We would like to inform those who want to purchase from overseas that there is a lack of transparency. I have never experienced anything like this (spending $300 on nothing). I do not recommend Elborn if you are looking to purchase from overseas but have not tried the product or seen it in person. The bag costs $700 on the website, but asking me to cover $300 of that is ridiculous.

reviews.text: I went to the newly opened MOSAIC HANNAM in Hannam-dong. It is a space where you can enjoy shopping and relaxation at the same time as there is a fashion store and a cafe. The fashion store is open from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m., and the cafe is open from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m., making it a great place to visit at your leisure. Perhaps because it was the first day of opening, the clean interior and lively atmosphere were impressive, and the location was easy to find as it was located in the center of Itaewon-ro. I think I will be stopping by often in the future as it is a space where you can experience fashion and lifestyle at the same time.
